title: $j_!$ preserves bounded constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and let $j\colon U\to X$ be an open immersion of
the setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. If $K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_U})$ is bounded constructible
([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), then so is the levelwise extension by zero
$D(j_!)K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ ([sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek],
[sk-prop-sfb-module-derived-factorization]).

proof.text:
The extension by zero $j_!$ on module objects is exact ([sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]). So
$H^q(D(j_!)K)\cong j_!H^q(K)$, and $D(j_!)K$ is bounded. Let $M$ be a constructible
$\Lambda_U$-module ([sk-def-sfb-constructible]) with finite stratification $U=\bigsqcup_aU_a$
such that each $M|_{U_a}$ is locally finitely presented. Each $U_a$ is locally closed in $X$, since
$U$ is open. So the $U_a$ together with the reduced closed complement $X\setminus U$ form a
finite stratification of $X$. On $U_a$ the restriction of $j_!M$ is $M|_{U_a}$, because
$j^*j_!\cong\mathrm{id}$. On $X\setminus U$ it is $0$, which is finitely presented. Hence $j_!M$
is constructible.
